scope: After Quality Works, Optimize: preserve Hero Street v2 art while keeping laptop-browser runtime practical.

balanced.notes: Default profile. Keeps the approved look and chunked hero-street runtime.

performance.notes: Opt-in laptop-safety profile. Keeps hero-street chunks but trims optional boats, reeds, birds, smoke, anisotropy, and LOD distance.

cinematic.notes: Opt-in inspection profile with higher anisotropic filtering and later LOD drop-out.

runtimePolicy.sourceOfTruth: The active residential street runtime must load the near/mid/far GLB chunks, not the full fallback corridor.

futureCompressionGate.draco: Remain opt-in until Babylon decoder loading is verified on local and deployed browser builds.
futureCompressionGate.meshopt: Do not require Meshopt until decoder path and visual regression screenshots are added.
futureCompressionGate.ktx2: Do not require KTX2 until Basis/KTX2 transcoder loading is verified and screenshots match the uncompressed atlas pass.
